text:
zoe: quick flag  proposing a small sidebar IA experiment: compress left nav into three buckets (Workspaces / Model registry / Observability). intent: reduce scan time for new users and make deep-links predictable for external tooling. thinking visual breadcrumb compression (show 'Workspace  > ModelName') while preserving full path in the URL. also propose server+client shim for legacy hash links.

jon: eng: +1 path-based routing only. hashes cause browser-history surprises. client shim on mount can replaceState() for legacy `/#/` patterns; also add server redirects for direct hits.

mira: a11y: each bucket must be a real nav landmark (role="navigation" aria-label="Workspaces" etc.), add a skiplinks bar for keyboard users, and aria-current="page" on last breadcrumb. announce truncation via polite live region.

lee: UX: rename "Models & Assets" -> "Model registry"; keep assets as a tooltip/sub-menu. breadcrumb separator should be chevrons and middle crumbs collapse to an ellipsis on narrow widths.

priya: rollout: feature-flag by org, canary 10% sessions then ramp. monitor deep-link success, session time to first action, and search usage. rollback if >15% regression.

jon: will open RFC PR and push a small staging preview.

deploy-bot: preview-deploy: staging/sidebar-compact available at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/sidebar-compact (expires in 72h)

mira: thanks, leaving PR ownership to @jon and a11y sign-off to @mira. closing thread.
